name: Cap of Water Breathing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Bubble of Air
powers.text: Underwater, a bubble of air forms around your head so you breathe normally.

summary: Underwater, a bubble of air forms around your head so you can breathe.
text: When you're underwater and wearing the cap, a Magic action wraps your head in a bubble of air that lets you breathe as normal. The bubble persists until you take that action again, remove the cap, or leave the water.
